svg.title: Receipt of work: Kumar Satvik Chaudhary
svg.desc: An animated receipt printing out of a thermal printer. Research: SMoA (PAKDD 2025); CyberBOT (CIKM 2025, Best Demo Paper award); EssayCBM (ECML-PKDD 2026); Trustworthy Education in the Era of Generative AI survey (SSRN 2026); REC-CBM (SDM 2026, AI4Good at ICML 2026). Education: Arizona State University, MS Computer Science (accelerated, May 2027), BS Computer Science with a Data Science minor (May 2026), GPA 4.00. Projects: Footnote, Tally, Voot. Now building: tally-sql-agent, footnote, Python-Full-Course. Total: shows his work. A QR code links to Google Scholar.
